author: om3gaholdings
name: rds-silk
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Silk style. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. 4-color palette (#140A00, #1E1D1D, #FFC300, #FFF1B8). Features: cursor-reactive (swirl). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
